semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Selvid Co., Ltd. provides essential components and equipment for manufacturing processes in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Selvid Co., Ltd. is a key distributor and service center for EKK Eagle Industry in Korea, specializing in high-quality components such as Magnetic Fluid Vacuum Seals, Rotary Joints, Metal Bellows, Pressure Sensors, and Load Cells. These products are crucial for manufacturing processes in the semiconductor, flat panel display, and solar industries.

regional_presence.Korea: Selvid Co., Ltd. acts as the official distributor and service center for EKK Eagle Industry, focusing on the Korean market.
